note: MOD_PLAN A44 (epoch bandit, branch work/a44-bandit; the build must contain it). Run with --tier screen first. Every arm sets STRATA_VERIFY_DEFER_CPU=1 (the fast-hip preset has no deferral, and the rank guard needs it; test 01's A4 numbers were on a deferred base). Fixed arms: defer (= the bandit's 'off'), defer-top2 (A4: best on edit), defer-kmiss (A5). Goal: bandit-top >= defer on short AND >= defer-top2 on edit (each within noise), i.e. the per-case best fixed arm on both; bandit-top-kmiss the same with k-th miss in the bandit. bandit-exact toggles kmiss + preread only (STRATA_BANDIT_EXACT=1: the lossy rank guard is not in it, top stays off here) - its text should hash like defer whenever kmiss is out of the picture; compare with defer-kmiss. The bandit learns over the process: the abtest warm-up request and earlier reps teach it, so rep 1 is its slowest. stderr has 'strata bandit:' lines (STRATA_BANDIT_LOG=1: one per epoch; one per request always) and the DONE line a bandit= field (the turn log keeps it). Lossy: the bandit arms' text depends on timings (top: lossy small; kmiss: rounding); expect hash differences between reps of the same bandit arm.
